script.spoken: PYLON FAILS AT TAKE-OFF. The jet rolled over and crashed, killing everyone aboard and two on the ground. The damage had been done weeks earlier, during maintenance. To save time, workers removed engine and pylon together with a forklift. That cracked the pylon's mounting. At take-off, it broke and cut hydraulic lines. The slats on one wing retracted, and that wing stalled. The shortcut was banned, and slats got protection against retracting.
